name: 11ai-comms
description: Communication registers that set how an agent speaks: the length, density, and shape of its replies.

interface.shortDescription: Set how the agent speaks and how much.
interface.longDescription: One skill per communication direction, so a session can pick a voice and hold it. Each register controls reply length, density, and shape without dropping evidence: numbers, paths, commands, error text, and stated uncertainty always survive.
interface.defaultPrompt: Help me use the 11ai-comms skills to set how you speak for the rest of this session.
